intent: knowledge layer: enterprise-configuration blueprint (banner-marked historical) + reference-notes and .includes/charters scaffolds
notes: `.gator/blueprints/enterprise-configuration.md`: adds a 407-line Codex-authored blueprint mapping the OLD Enterprise-mvp configuration model (three-scope: server / machine / repo; activate + sync + repo-init sequence; machine-local vs repo-local vs server-side state; commit-time behavior; credentials model; hook model; E8 encryption extension). Prepended with a **HISTORICAL** banner marking it as pre-transcripts-first — the current MVP does NOT follow this model. Banner cross-references the MVP plan §2 D2 OBSOLETE list and points readers to the ADR for the current design.

Retained per Architect direction 2026-08-09 (stabilization plan Phase 1 §6 needs-review disposition) so future work can trace the legacy configuration architecture the current code paths still partly implement. Not to be used as guidance for new work.

`.gator/reference-notes/{README,_template}.md`: adds repo-user reference-notes scaffolding at repo-root scope. Constitution.md §File Purposes lists `.gator/reference-notes/` as a valid location for repo-user reference notes; scaffold signals to future contributors that this is where THIS repo's cognitive-aid notes go (as distinct from `.gator/.includes/reference-notes/` which is the shipped-to-customers scaffolding).

`.gator/.includes/charters/{README,_template.md}`: adds shipped-to-new-repos charter scaffolding under the v2 `.includes/` tree. `_template.md` (650 bytes) byte-identical with `.gator/charters/_template.md`; `README.md` (15048 bytes) is the customer-facing charter philosophy README (620 bytes slimmer than this repo's own `.gator/charters/README.md` which has repo-specific additions). Preserves v2 layout scaffolding; retirement (if the Architect later decides charters should never ship as `.includes/` content) is post-3.0 cleanup.
Fifth of six checkpoint commits per stabilization plan Phase 1 §6.
